findings.title: DST gap/ambiguous wall times are resolved implicitly, so the run can fire at a different local time than run_at
findings.recommendation: Detect nonexistent and ambiguous wall times explicitly: build the candidate with fold=0 and fold=1, compare their utcoffset(); if they differ the time is ambiguous (pick a documented policy, e.g. first occurrence), if the combined result does not round-trip back to the same wall time it is nonexistent (document whether to skip the day or shift forward). Example reachable path: tz_name='America/New_York', run_at=time(2, 30), after=2024-03-10T06:00Z -> combine yields 02:30 with the pre-transition

findings.title: Timezone-aware run_at is silently stripped instead of rejected
findings.evidence: wall = run_at.replace(tzinfo=None)  # run_at is a wall time in tz
findings.evidence_quote: wall = run_at.replace(tzinfo=None)  # run_at is a wall time in tz
findings.recommendation: Validate the input: if run_at.tzinfo is not None and run_at.utcoffset() is not None, either convert it into tz_name or raise ValueError, rather than dropping the offset. Otherwise a caller passing time(9, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo')) with tz_name='UTC' silently gets a 09:00 UTC run instead of 00:00 UTC - a wrong schedule with no error.
